This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Nature Valley arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Nature has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to retreat from handlers when they attempted to interact with or handle her. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Nature Valley
